summary: Dana Inc. filed an 8-K on June 11, 2026, disclosing a Reverse Morris Trust transaction with Eaton Corporation. Under the definitive agreement, Eaton will spin off its Vehicle and eMobility business segments into SpinCo via a distribution (spin-off or exchange offer), then Merger Sub will merge into Dana, with Dana surviving as a wholly-owned subsidiary of SpinCo (renamed Dana Incorporated). Former Eaton shareholders will own at least 50.1% and former Dana shareholders ~49.9% of SpinCo common stock. Each Dana share converts to one SpinCo share. No premium, price per share, or advisors were disclosed. The transaction is structured as a tax-efficient Reverse Morris Trust. Watch for shareholder approvals, regulatory clearances, and tax ruling.
